## The question

[Node with tikz and bookmarks](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/7151/node-with-tikz-and-bookmarks), asked by [Arianna Angeletti](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/2312/arianna-angeletti) on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-12-15; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> Is it possible to link a bookmark to the command `\titA` in the following example?  
>
> ```latex
>     \documentclass{article}
>     \usepackage{tikz}
>     \usetikzlibrary{shadows}
>     \newcommand{\titA}[1]{\begin{tikzpicture} \node[circle,shading=ball, ball color=red!80!white, minimum size=1cm]{#1};\end{tikzpicture}}
>     \begin{document}
>     \titA{blah blah}
>     \end{document}
> ```
:::

Use the [`bookmark`](http://ctan.org/pkg/bookmark/) package.

```latex
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{shadows}
\usepackage{lipsum}
\usepackage{bookmark}

\newcommand{\titA}[1]{%
    \bookmark[page=\value{page}]{#1}
    \begin{tikzpicture} 
        \node[circle,shading=ball, ball color=red!80!white, minimum size=1cm]{#1};
    \end{tikzpicture}%
}
\begin{document}

\titA{blah blah}

\lipsum

\titA{foo bar}

\lipsum

\end{document}
```
